帐.def: tent, screen, mosquito net; debt, credit, account

origin.says: Simplified from 帳: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 长 (long) as the sound: cloth stretched out, a tent or curtain. Later also 'accounts' (now usually 账).

帐.name: tent

origin.says: Two 火 (fire) stacked: fire upon fire, a blazing flame; hot, and today also 'inflammation'.
少 (little) and 力 (strength) combine: having little strength, so inferior, poor in quality. Some sources take 力 as a sound part too.

Simplified from 鳳, first a drawing of a crested bird, later 凡 (ordinary) added as the sound and the bird written 鳥 (bird). The simplified form keeps the 凡 frame and puts 又 (hand) in place of the bird as a mere filler.
First just 皇 (emperor); the 𠘨 frame was copied from 鳳 (male phoenix) so the pair looked alike: the female phoenix.

锻.def: to temper, to refine; to forge metal

origin.says: Simplified from 鍛: 金 (metal) became 钅. 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 段 (section, first 'to forge') as the sound and sense: 'to forge, to temper'.

锻.name: forge

艘.def: measure word for ships or vessels

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 叟 (old man) as the sound: the counting word for ships.

艘.name: ship counter

origin.says: A picture of a rabbit: long ears on top, body and legs, with the dot as its tail. The shape now looks like 免 (avoid) plus a dot.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 母 (mother) as the sound: a woman who brings up children, a nanny.

裹.def: to wrap, to encircle; to confine, to bind

origin.says: 衣 (clothing) for the meaning plus 果 (fruit) as the sound, with the 果 set inside the split 衣: to wrap in cloth, to bind, to bundle.

裹.name: swaddle

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 干 (dry) as the sound: water on the skin, sweat.

凝.def: to coagulate, to congeal; to freeze

origin.says: 冫 (ice) for the meaning plus 疑 (doubt) as the sound: to freeze, to congeal.

凝.name: congeal

添.def: to add, to append, to increase, to replenish

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 忝 (to shame) as the sound: to pour in more water, to add.

添.name: top up

origin.says: 月 (flesh, body organ) for the meaning plus 卑 (lowly) as the sound: the spleen, once thought to hold one's temper, hence disposition.
Shortened from 釐, which had a sound part over 里 (village); the modern form keeps only 厂 (cliff) of the top and 里: a tiny unit, one thousandth or one hundredth.

诱.def: to tempt, to persuade, to entice; guide

ety.hint: To use elegant 秀 words 讠; 秀 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 秀 (elegant) as the sound: luring with words, to entice. Simplified from 誘.

诱.name: lure

ety.hint: A person 尸 walking 彳; 復 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Bronze forms show a person with a foot (止) in a boat-shaped shoe (舟). The seal form reads as 尸 (person) + 彳 (road) + 夊 (foot) + 舟 (shoe): to walk, a shoe. The shoe 舟 later became 复.

荡.def: pond, pool; ripple, shake; to wash away, to wipe out

ety.hint: Hot water 汤 wiping out plant life 艹; 汤 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 湯 (hot water) as the sound: a reed pond; also to sway, to wash away. Simplified from 蕩 (and 盪), with 汤 for 湯.

荡.name: sway

涌.def: to surge up, to bubble up, to gush forth

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 甬 (bell) as the sound: water surging up. The full form 湧 had 勇 (brave) as the sound; the simplified form took over the old variant 涌.

涌.name: gush

origin.says: 钅 (metal) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: the pound sterling, a coin. Simplified from 鎊 (釒 → 钅).

辨.def: to recognize, to distinguish, to discriminate

ety.hint: To separate 刂 two alternatives 辛

origin.says: 辡 (two 辛, prisoners' knives, or two parties disputing) as the sound with 刀 (knife, here a short form) set between them: to cut apart, to tell apart.

辨.name: distinguish

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 民 (people) as the sound: closing the eyes to sleep.
⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 既 (already) as the sound: a stirred heart, to sigh, also 'generous'.
Simplified from 謠: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 䍃 (a pot shape) as the sound: songs sung without music, folk songs, then rumors; 言 became 讠.

ety.hint: Flesh ⺼ beside 旁 the body; 旁 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: the shoulder, the upper arm, a wing; the parts at the sides of the body.
莫 (do not) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning: a grave in the ground.
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 翏 (high flight) as the sound: false words, an error, absurd. Simplified from 謬 by writing 言 (speech) as 讠.
Simplified from 飽: 饣 (food) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: to have eaten your fill. Only the food part was simplified.

拘.def: to detain, to restrain, to seize

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound, which also hints at holding: to seize, to detain.

拘.name: detain

origin.says: 月 (here the flesh part from 肉 meat) for the meaning plus 土 (earth) as the sound: belly, stomach. A fairly late character.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: the cypress tree.

哼.def: to hum; to sing softly; to moan, to groan

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 亨 (go smoothly) as the sound: a sound made in the mouth, humming or groaning.

哼.name: hum

origin.says: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 屈 (bend) as the sound: a peak rising up abruptly, towering, a sudden rise.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 息 (breath; also 'son' in old use) as the sound: a son's wife, daughter-in-law.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 采 (pluck) as the sound: to step on, to stamp.

噢.def: to moan; interjection indicating pain or sadness

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 荒 (wasteland) as the sound: a flustered heart, panic.
From 飢: 食 (food) for the meaning plus 几 (small table) as the sound: hungry. 食 became 饣, and the form also took over 饑 (famine), which had 幾 as its sound.

扭.def: to turn, to twist, to wrench; to grasp, to seize

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 丑 (clawed hand) as the sound: to twist, wrench with the hand.

扭.name: twist

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 巿 (apron) as the sound: the organ of breath, the lungs.
Simplified from 腫: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 重 (heavy) as the sound, a swelling. The simplified form swaps 重 for the simpler, similar-sounding 中 (middle).

ety.hint: A man bringing home meat ⺼ for the family 户

origin.says: A drawing of the shoulder joint above ⺝ (flesh, body part): the shoulder. The shoulder drawing now looks like 户 (door).
此 (this) as the sound plus 糸 (silk) for the meaning: silk dyed purple.

酬.def: to toast, to entertain; to reward, to compensate

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar) for the meaning plus 州 (province) as the sound: to return a toast to a host, hence to repay, to reward.

酬.name: toast

缠.def: to wrap, to entangle; to involve; to bother, to annoy

origin.says: Simplified from 纏: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 廛 (shop, dwelling) as the sound: to wind thread around, entangle. 廛 was cut down to 广 over 里.

缠.name: wrap around

敲.def: to hammer, to pound, to strike

origin.says: 高 (tall) as the sound plus 攴 (tap, strike) for the meaning: to knock or hammer.

敲.name: knock

ety.hint: Like 亦 a bow 弓

origin.says: 弓 (bow) for the meaning plus a sound part: to bend like a bow. Simplified from 彎, whose long sound part was replaced by the shape 亦.

亩.def: fields; unit of area equal to 660 sq. m.

origin.says: Simplified from 畝: first 田 (field) for the meaning plus 每 (each) as the sound; a mark 十 was later added on top and turned into 亠. The simplified form drops the 久 on the right.

亩.name: field unit

origin.says: Simplified from 蠻: 䜌 (tangled threads) as the sound plus 虫 (snake, creature), a scornful word for southern tribes. The simplification wrote the 䜌 part as 亦 (also).

胶.def: glue, gum, resin, rubber; sticky; to glue

ety.hint: Tendons that connect 交 muscles ⺼; 交 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 膠: ⺼ (flesh) for the meaning plus 翏 as the sound: glue boiled from hides and bones. The simplified form replaces 翏 with 交 (jiāo, join), which fits both sound and meaning.

胶.name: glue

佣.def: to hire, to employ; commission; servant

ety.hint: An employed 用 person 亻; 用 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: From 傭: 亻 (person) plus 庸 (to use) as the sound: a person hired for use, a servant. 庸 was replaced by 用 (use), an old form with the same sound.

佣.name: hired hand

庇.def: cover, shield; to protect, to shelter; to harbor

origin.says: 广 (shelter against a cliff) for the meaning plus 比 (compare) as the sound: to cover and protect.

庇.name: shelter

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 农 (farming) as the sound: a liquid that is thick and strong. Simplified from 濃, whose sound part 農 (farming) was replaced by its simple form 农.

堕.def: to drop, to fall, to sink; degenerate

origin.says: Simplified from 墮: 隋 (a dynasty name) as the sound plus 土 (earth) for the meaning, to fall. The simplified form drops the 工 of 隋, leaving 陏.

堕.name: degenerate

origin.says: 自 (self), first a drawing of a nose, plus 畀 (to give) as the sound. When 自 came to mean self, this longer form took over 'nose'.
From 繩: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 黾 (frog) as the sound: a rope. Simplified by writing both parts in their short forms.

嫌.def: to hate, to detest; to criticize; to suspect

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 兼 (both) as the sound: 'to dislike, to suspect' (the woman sign appears in several words for feelings).

嫌.name: dislike

origin.says: 辛 (bitter, pungent) for the meaning plus 束 (bundle), a cut-down form of 剌, as the sound: hot, spicy.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 厓 (cliff edge) for the sound and meaning: the water's edge, a shore, then any limit or horizon.

捡.def: to pick up, to gather, to collect

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: to pick up with the hand. Simplified from 撿 by shortening 僉 to 佥.

捡.name: collect up

咋.def: question-forming particle: why? what? how?; to bite; loud

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly) as the sound: first "to bite, loud"; now mainly a spoken word for "how? why?".

咋.name: how come

ety.hint: Small niches 幺 in the mountainside 山; 幺 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 𢆶 (two tiny threads) as the sound plus 山 (mountain), which was 火 (fire) in the oldest forms: dim, hidden, secluded.

烤.def: to bake, to cook, to roast, to toast

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 考 (to test; old age) as the sound: to roast or bake over fire. A late character; the older word was written 熇 (to scorch).

烤.name: roast

笼.def: basket; cage; bamboo basket used to serve dimsum

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 龙 (dragon) as the sound: a bamboo basket or cage, also a steamer basket. Simplified from 籠, with 龍 written 龙.

笼.name: cage

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 宛 (winding) as the sound: a bowl. Older variants used 皿 (dish) or 木 (wood) as the meaning part, after the bowl's material.

ety.hint: Two objects 口 strung 丨 together

origin.says: A picture of two objects strung on a skewer or a cord: a string of things, to string together.

寒.def: chilly, cold; poor; to shiver, to tremble

origin.says: 宀 (house) with a person among bundles of grass, and two marks below later read as ice (⺀): a person in a house bedded in straw against the cold. The middle has since fused into one block.

寒.name: chilly

origin.says: Simplified from 竊 (steal), whose old parts were rice and a hand doing something, under 穴 (hole), with a sound part. The simplified form keeps 穴 (hole, a burrow to sneak through) and swaps the rest for 切 (cut) as the sound.
Simplified from 顛: 真 (true) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: the top of the head, a summit; falling head first gives 'to topple, to jolt'.

Originally a drawing of a man holding a carpenter's square; the man changed into 矢 (arrow) and the square became 巨 (huge). Meaning: the square, hence a rule or pattern. An old dictionary misread it as a compound.
父 (father) for the meaning plus 多 (many) as the sound: dad, a colloquial word for father.

臭.def: to reek, to smell, to stink

ety.hint: The smell 自 of a dirty dog 犬

origin.says: 犬 (dog) under 自 (nose): the dog's keen nose, to smell. It came to mean a bad smell, and 嗅 (sniff) took over the old meaning.

臭.name: stink
